statement: The research team needs repeatable measurements of hop height in a reduced-gravity analogue.
acceptance_criteria: Team lead confirms data set supports locomotion analysis

statement: The test rig shall record vertical displacement of the prototype at a sampling rate of at least 200 Hz.
rationale: Hop apex occurs within 0.5 s; 200 Hz gives >= 100 samples per ascent
acceptance_criteria: Logged sample interval <= 5.0 ms for 3 consecutive trials

statement: The test rig shall remove actuator power within 100 ms of emergency-stop activation.
rationale: Limits stored energy release during a fault
acceptance_criteria: Measured power-removal latency <= 100 ms in 10 of 10 activations

statement: The displacement sensor shall have a resolution of 1 mm or finer over a 0-2000 mm range.
rationale: Needed to resolve hop height differences of 5 mm
acceptance_criteria: Calibration certificate shows resolution <= 1 mm; bench check against gauge blocks within 1 mm
